priorAttempts.outcome: wave1 and wave10 passed; wave200 acquired 200/200, then all 200 installs failed on this laptop before reaching a Sandbox (no download attempted)
priorAttempts.cause: The driver laptop resolves each <port>-<sandboxId>.<domain> host separately and its resolver serialises distinct lookups (200 names took ~22 s, also with UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=128), so connections timed out; gateway logs show no errors. Fixed in the driver with one cached lookup for *.<E2B_DOMAIN> (all such hosts are CNAMEs of the gateway ALB). In-cluster Runners use one service URL and do not resolve per-Sandbox names.
